Body.Content:
Traffic Analytics, a cloud based network audit and compliance solution, now provides faster insights into user and application activity on cloud networks. The new Traffic Analytics accelerated processing option processes network security group (NSG) flow logs at ten minute intervals and therefore provides faster security and network insights.

Learn more about Traffic Analytics
